mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a crisp 56 degrees with clear skies at Verona City Hall, and please be aware that the air quality is moderate at 59. We are currently under a New Moon.

The City of Verona recently reached a major milestone with the Common Council unanimously adopting the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This new long-range vision was developed through extensive community input and will focus on strengthening neighborhoods, supporting local businesses, and promoting sustainable growth.

There is a busy day ahead for our community. Today, you can check out the Dane County Farmers Market, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, or head to Century School Park for the Puppets in the Park festival. Looking ahead, yoga is scheduled for October 12 at Insight Wellness, and trivia games are lined up for next week at Hop Haus and Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call from Sunday, September 28, a 16-year-old was cited for reckless driving and operating a motorcycle without a license following a collision on Enterprise Drive.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Raspberry Cheesecake. If you are planning a visit, please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
